name: H1
summary: Unitree's first full-size humanoid, a high-power research platform that set a walking-speed record for full-size humanoids (about 3.3 m/s) and performed a standing backflip in 2024. Sold from roughly US$90,000, it made athletic full-size humanoid hardware broadly available to labs a year before the cheaper G1.
notable: Speed record for a full-size humanoid (~3.3 m/s)
First mass-priced full-size humanoid to do a standing backflip
